datasets.name: ds_suburb_sarah
datasets.displayName: Suburb Comparison (rent, flood, amenities, transit, safety)
datasets.query:
WITH suburb_hazard AS (
  SELECT
    hc.suburb_id,
    BOOL_OR(hz.in_flood_plain)              AS any_flood_plain,
    BOOL_OR(hz.in_coastal_inundation_1_aep) AS any_coastal
  FROM housing.gold.h3_cell hc
  JOIN housing.gold.hazard hz ON hz.h3_cell = hc.h3_cell
  GROUP BY hc.suburb_id
),
suburb_amenity AS (
  SELECT
    suburb_id,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN amenity_type IN ('school','early_childhood') THEN 1 END) AS education_count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN amenity_type = 'supermarket'                 THEN 1 END) AS supermarket_count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN amenity_type = 'park'                        THEN 1 END) AS park_count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN amenity_type IN ('hospital','pharmacy','gp_clinic') THEN 1 END) AS health_count
  FROM housing.gold.amenity__h3
  GROUP BY suburb_id
),
suburb_transit AS (
  SELECT
    hc.suburb_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ts.stop_id) AS transit_stops
  FROM housing.gold.transit_stop ts
  JOIN housing.gold.h3_cell hc ON hc.h3_cell = ts.h3_cell
  GROUP BY hc.suburb_id
),
ta_crime AS (
  SELECT
    territorial_authority,
    ROUND(AVG(total_victimisations), 1) AS avg_monthly_victimisations
  FROM housing.gold.area_unit__month
  GROUP BY territorial_authority
)
SELECT
  s.suburb_id,
  s.suburb_name,
  s.territorial_authority,
  s.region,
  s.population_2023,
  sy.median_weekly_rent,
  sy.median_household_income,
  ROUND(sy.median_weekly_rent * 52 / NULLIF(sy.median_household_income, 0) * 100, 1) AS rent_to_income_pct,
  sy.owner_occupier_pct,
  sy.percent_crowded,
  sy.dwellings_no_heating,
  ROUND(sy.dwellings_always_damp * 100.0 / NULLIF(sy.dwellings_damp_total_stated, 0), 1) AS pct_always_damp,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(sh.any_flood_plain, FALSE) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS flood_plain,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(sh.any_coastal, FALSE)      THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS coastal_risk,
  COALESCE(sa.education_count, 0)      AS education_nearby,
  COALESCE(sa.supermarket_count, 0)    AS supermarkets_nearby,
  COALESCE(sa.park_count, 0)           AS parks_nearby,
  COALESCE(sa.health_count, 0)         AS health_nearby,
  COALESCE(st.transit_stops, 0)        AS transit_stops,
  tc.avg_monthly_victimisations        AS ta_avg_monthly_crime,
  CASE
    WHEN sy.median_weekly_rent IS NULL THEN '7. Not available'
    WHEN sy.median_weekly_rent <= 400  THEN '1. Under $400 / week'
    WHEN sy.median_weekly_rent <= 500  THEN '2. $400 to $500 / week'
    WHEN sy.median_weekly_rent <= 600  THEN '3. $500 to $600 / week'
    WHEN sy.median_weekly_rent <= 750  THEN '4. $600 to $750 / week'
    WHEN sy.median_weekly_rent <= 1000 THEN '5. $750 to $1,000 / week'
    ELSE                                    '6. Over $1,000 / week'
  END                                  AS rent_bucket,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(sa.education_count,0) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_schools,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(st.transit_stops,0) >= 5  THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS good_transit
FROM housing.gold.suburb s
LEFT JOIN housing.gold.suburb__year sy
  ON sy.suburb_id = s.suburb_id AND sy.census_year = 2023
LEFT JOIN suburb_hazard sh ON sh.suburb_id = s.suburb_id
LEFT JOIN suburb_amenity sa ON sa.suburb_id = s.suburb_id
LEFT JOIN suburb_transit st ON st.suburb_id = s.suburb_id
LEFT JOIN ta_crime tc ON tc.territorial_authority = s.territorial_authority
WHERE s.population_2023 > 500
ORDER BY s.territorial_authority, s.suburb_name

datasets.name: ds_amenities_map
datasets.query:
SELECT
  osm_id,
  amenity_type,
  name,
  lat,
  lon,
  suburb_id
FROM housing.gold.amenity__h3
WHERE amenity_type IN ('school','early_childhood','supermarket','park','hospital','pharmacy','gp_clinic','library')

datasets.name: ds_transit_map
datasets.query:
SELECT
  ts.stop_id,
  ts.stop_name,
  ts.stop_lat,
  ts.stop_lon,
  ts.feed_source,
  hc.suburb_id
FROM housing.gold.transit_stop ts
LEFT JOIN housing.gold.h3_cell hc ON hc.h3_cell = ts.h3_cell
